Name: Improved Penny Vanilla Portrait
Author: badboyzay
Description:
Penny vanilla portrait is fine, but it looks weird with the other side of her hair not showing. I know her portrait meant to indicate she's looking at you sideway but her hair seems fluffy enough (as indicated in her sprite) to not so easily be hidden, so I put that side of her hair into her portrait. This is for those who prefer the way she looks in vanilla and a portrait that reflects her sprite better.

[b]How to install:
[/b]Simply put the content in your Stardew Valley folder.

[b]Permission:
[/b]You are free to do whatever you want with my mods as long as you credit me.
